SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category,
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey != 1) AS promoted_revenue,
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey = 1) AS full_price_revenue,
    sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey != 1) - sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey = 1) AS incremental_revenue_vs_full_price,
    (sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey != 1) - sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey = 1)) * 100.0
        / nullIf(sumIf(fos.SalesAmount, fos.PromotionKey = 1), 0) AS incremental_revenue_pct_vs_full_price
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON fos.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS psc
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = psc.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON psc.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY incremental_revenue_vs_full_price DESC
